messages:
eli: Heads up — we're seeing sustained allocation failures and OOM evictions on west-3 dedicated GPU pool. 95th latency is climbing, queues are backlogged, and a few nodes have gone into degraded mode. Not auto-failing to hosted yet but capacity is effectively saturated.

sre-bot: [alert] west-3.dedicated.pools.gpu.evictions > 200 in last 5m — nodes reporting degraded resource pressure

maya: @eli can you paste the short metrics slice and the grafana link? need numbers to decide weights

eli: queued ~1.2k, token/sec drop ~40%. quick metrics snapshot:
```
/api/metrics?m=dedicated.west-3:
evictions=218
queued_requests=1223
active_nodes=42 -> 36
```

jordan: Recommend a graceful shift to hosted. Proposal: staged override — hosted 35% / dedicated 65% for non-enterprise orgs for 30 minutes, then reassess. Keep enterprise pinned to dedicated as a canary.

sophie: +1 on staged shift. note: hosted run-rate for these models is approx 2x cost — finance should be looped if this stays for >1h. Also watch KV-cache hit rate, it impacts latency a lot when crossing to hosted variants.

eli: Can we apply a targeted routing override? example command:
```
curl -X POST https://orchestrator.internal/routing/override \\
  -d '{"region":"west-3","hosted_weight":0.35,"selector":"!tier:enterprise","duration_m":30}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN'
```

maya: I'm going to apply that now and bump autoscaler (requested 10 nodes, provisioning ETA ~12m). will monitor.

deploy-bot: routing override applied by maya at 1832104380 — hosted_weight=0.35 selector="!tier:enterprise" duration_m=30

sophie: Monitoring: errors down ~60%, p95 returning toward normal. KV cache hit for hosted requests is lower as expected (~12% -> 6%), keep an eye.

jordan: If new nodes finish provisioning we'll retract override and do gradual weight rollback. If not, extend duration and inform sales/support. Also suggest adding temporary cost-center tag "west3-failover-2026" for chargeback.

eli: Will open PR to add fallback cost-centers and note the affected model variants in the incident doc.

maya: override in place, autoscale request submitted, watching charts. will update here in 5m. :thumbsup:

eli: Thanks — I'll update the status page and ping #support with a brief customer note.
